text:
lee: APAC alert — sg-prod-eld cluster has a spike of GPU drains. 6 cards flagged by monitoring, 3 in rack r12. Opening thread for RMA/logistics coordination. cc @maria @sahil

maria: On it. Are these the same serials that failed last week? Any overlap with the spare manifests I uploaded?

lee: Different serials. Node gpunode-13 shows repeating ECC/Xid patterns, intermittent Xid 65 and Xid 43. Suspect flaky memory on card SN-AP-4501.

sahil: Can you paste the short `nvidia-smi` / ECC snippet?

lee: ```
$ nvidia-smi -q -d ECC
Product Name : A100-SXM4-80GB
GPU 0 (SN-AP-4501):
    ECC Errors
    Xid: 43
    Xid: 65 (repeated)
```

karen: FYI courier in SIN currently on hold due to customs backlog — last inbound shipment delayed ~48h. If we need depot swap via SIN, ETA increases. @logistics-team any alternate routing? :thinking_face: 

logistics-team: We can route spares from HKG next-day air but cost is ~USD 1.2k/card. Also SIN manifests show SN-AP-4501 marked as "installed", not "failed" — need serial reconciliation before vendor will accept RMA.

lee: Confirmed it shows as installed in host inventory but it's failing ECC repeatedly. I can reprovision the host to confirm card vs host but prefer to avoid taking redundancy down during business hours.

maria: Suggest draining the host and pulling a standby from HKG if possible. If not feasible, schedule a hot-swap in the non-peak window 02:00-05:00 SGT.

sahil: Opening vendor RMA now.
rma-bot: RMA ticket RMA-78234 created with vendor "NVIDIA-authorized" — ETA parts 7-10 business days (SIN depot).

karen: Given customs hold, vendor ETA may be optimistic. Ops: can we spin up a CPU-only fallback for the affected service? What's the cost delta?

jane: If we shift affected load to CPU fallback, estimated cost delta is +$0.08/token and ~200 instance hours/day => ~USD 6k/week. Not desirable but doable short-term.

lee: OK prioritize HKG standby route. @maria can you approve cross-dc move and update manifests so vendor will accept the serials? We need PM signoff too.

maria: Approved. I updated the manifest with note: "hold-for-serial-check" and added PM signoff.

logistics-team: Pickup scheduled for 2026-03-20 09:00 SGT from SIN depot. Will attach AWB once courier scans. If customs holds, we'll escalate.

sahil: Vendor asked for a photo of the serial label + `dmidecode` output. Lee, can you upload to ticket?

lee: Uploaded label photos and pasted `sudo dmidecode -t system | grep -i serial` output into RMA-78234 thread.

karen: :thumbsup: I'll add a short on-call runbook for triaging Xid 65: prefer drain+retest -> if persistent -> RMA.

maria: After swap, run `stress-ng --matrix` and 24h memtest on the replaced card.

lee: Reserving HKG standby card and awaiting AWB. I'll post updates on pickup scan and any vendor changes.

rma-bot: Update: vendor RMA status changed to "In Escrow" by SIN depot (hold for customs). Contact vendor rep: priya@vendor.com

logistics-team: Noted. If customs hold >5 days, escalate to vendor rep and consider express replacement from JP partner pool.

sahil: Adding postmortem ticket if replacement >7 days. cc @ashley for cost-impact approval.

ashley: Acknowledged. Prepare a cost estimate and tag chargeback to APAC infra budget.

lee: Thanks all — I'll update once courier scans pickup or if the node needs immediate isolation.
